LightningComponentBundle.description: GC-3183 Metadata-driven page shell that renders tabs, sections, fields, and components from DynamicPageElement CMDT.

property.name: pageName
property.label: Page Name
property.description: Metadata page key. Must match PageName__c on DynamicPageElement and DynamicPageAccessRule records. Example: Customer360

property.name: objectApiName
property.label: Object API Name
property.description: Record object for this page. Must match ObjectAPIName__c on the access rule. Example: Account

property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Card Title
property.description: Header text shown on the outer card. Example: Customer 360
